_comment: Token definitions. Referenced by create_token effects; never in a deck list. Hand-written, and edited only under /extend-dsl (its Tier 0, a gap record with kind 'token'). Three are created by no shipped card and stay as test fixtures: knight_2_2_w_vigilance (the near miss tests/unit/tokens/test_token_pool.py and tests/cards/test_authoring.py contrast with knight_2_2_w and samurai_2_2_w_vigilance), kraken_8_8_u (the 8/8 in tests/unit/triggers/test_once_each_turn_trigger.py and test_atraxa_tokens.py) and vampire_1_1_bw (made by a test-pool card in tests/data/testing.cards.json, and by test_sba_and_commander.py). The four 0/0 black Army tokens are named by no create_token: the amass op picks one by its subtype (ops_counters.AMASS_TOKENS). incubator_token is named only by the incubate op (ops_counters.INCUBATOR_TOKEN), and phyrexian_0_0_c_artifact is its back face, reached by transforming it and never created on its own.
